//: flow-feature.json — Track 1 标准通道（#feat / 单个明确 Feature 或常规 Bug，也是默认 flow.config.json 指向的轨道）。
//usage: node .orca/flow.mjs --config flow-feature.json "#feat <需求或常规 Bug 描述>"
//switch: 切换轨道：Track 0 (--config flow-hotfix.json) | Track 1 (默认 flow.config.json / --config flow-feature.json) | Track 2 (--config flow-epic.json)
//workflow: 轻量跳过完整 PO（<=10 行微型 Plan）-> 单 Worktree 编码+单测 ->（如涉 UI 走 Playwright 1440px+390px Visual Gate）-> 跨家族审查 (Max Retry=2) -> 提 PR 触发 CI。
//modelNote: 默认 model 均为 "default"（沿用各 CLI 自身默认配置，可自由替换为任意闭源或开源模型）。下方为参考推荐组合，如需锁定模型将对应步骤的 model 改为实际模型 ID 即可。

//recommendedModelPool.micro-plan & visual-gate: 参考：Gemini 4 Neon (Medium，禁止对 Carbon/Neon 开 Low) 或其他多模态模型。
//recommendedModelPool.coding (70% 常规): 参考：DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 (High；疑难 Bug 可临时切 Max) 或任意高吞吐开源/闭源编码模型。
//recommendedModelPool.coding (30% 复杂终端排错/深度重构): 参考：Kimi K3.1 Pro / Kimi K2.7 Code 或 GLM-5.3 (手动降为 Low/High，严禁放任 GLM-5.3 走默认 Max 卡死并发队列)。
//recommendedModelPool.code-review: 参考：GPT-6.2 Sol (High，绝对不要开 Max) 或任意与编码模型不同家族的强推理模型。
//recommendedModelPool.pr-submit: 参考：DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 (Low) 或 Hy4 flash / Gemini 4 Hydrogen (Low/Medium)。

pipeline.title: Micro Plan (<=10 lines)
pipeline.//recommendedModel: gemini-4-neon (effort: medium; never low) or any coordinator model
pipeline.spec: You are a Track 1 (#feat) lightweight coordinator. Skip full PO/Backlog ceremonies. Inspect the repo briefly and write {out} as a MICRO PLAN strictly within 10 bullet lines covering: (1) exact goal & scope, (2) target files to touch, (3) unit test cases to add/update, (4) whether UI/UX is touched (`UI_TOUCHED: yes|no` — if yes, Visual Gate applies against DESIGN.md), and (5) acceptance criteria. Do NOT write code.

pipeline.title: Single-Worktree Coding & Unit Tests
pipeline.//recommendedModel: deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017 (effort: high) or kimi-k3.1-pro / glm-5.3 (low/high, never max)
pipeline.spec: You are a Track 1 single-worktree coding worker. FIRST ACTION - TASK CHECKLIST: break down {reads} into a Markdown checklist in {tasks} ('- [ ]' / '- [~]' / '- [x]') and update it live. Implement the feature/bugfix cleanly in this worktree, add/update unit tests, and run lint, typecheck, and unit tests until green. If UI is touched, follow DESIGN.md strictly (anti-AI-slop rules, 4 states: Default/Loading Skeleton/Empty/Error, component reuse) and capture Playwright screenshots (1440px desktop + 390px mobile) under .orca/artifacts/screenshots/ if available. If re-run after failed visual-gate or code-review, read VISUAL_GATE.md and REVIEW.md and resolve every issue. Write {out} with changed files, design/test notes, and command outputs.

pipeline.title: Visual Gate (UI/UX Check)
pipeline.//recommendedModel: gemini-4-neon (effort: medium; never low) or any vision-capable reviewer model
pipeline.spec: You are the Track 1 UI/UX Visual Gate reviewer. Check {reads}: if MICRO_PLAN.md and git diff confirm NO UI/UX files were modified (`UI_TOUCHED: no`), record 'Visual Gate skipped (backend/non-UI change)' in {out} and return PASS (outcome=succeeded). Otherwise, inspect DESIGN.md and verify Playwright screenshots at 1440px desktop and 390px mobile (capture them into .orca/artifacts/screenshots/ if not yet captured). Audit strictly: token compliance, restrained whitespace, crisp typography hierarchy, 1px subtle borders, NO AI-slop purple/blue gradients or decorative filler cards, component reuse, and 4-state completeness (Default/Loading Skeleton/Empty/Error). Write {out} with VERDICT: PASS or FAIL (outcome=failed loops back to coding, maxRetries=2). End {out} with the final non-empty line strictly as `VERDICT: PASS` or `VERDICT: FAIL`.

pipeline.title: Cross-Family Code Review
pipeline.//recommendedModel: gpt-6.2-sol (effort: high; NEVER max) or any cross-family senior reviewer model
pipeline.spec: You are a Track 1 cross-family senior reviewer. Review git diff against {reads} and AGENTS.md. Check correctness, edge cases, security basics, test quality, and adherence to scope. Write {out} with BLOCKER/MAJOR/MINOR findings and VERDICT: if any BLOCKER/MAJOR exists, report FAIL (outcome=failed) to loop back to coding (hard cap Max Retry = 2); otherwise PASS. End {out} with the final non-empty line strictly as `VERDICT: PASS` or `VERDICT: FAIL`.

pipeline.title: Reviewer PR Create & Merge to Target Branch
pipeline.spec: You are the Track 1 Release Reviewer. Based on {reads}: (1) verify current branch is a `feat/<slug>` or `fix/<slug>` branch (NEVER push directly to `{protectedBranches}` and NEVER auto-merge into `{protectedBranches}`); (2) commit clean changes (never commit .orca/artifacts/), push with `git push -u origin HEAD`, create/update a Pull Request targeting `{targetBranch}` (`--base {targetBranch}`), and once CI + Visual Gate + Code Review are green on non-protected `{targetBranch}` (e.g. `dev`), merge into `{targetBranch}`; (3) write PR URL, merge commit SHA, and verification checklist to {out}.
